dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.console.followHyperlinkAction.apiChange>
<!description: Update FollowHyperlinkAction constructor usage from TextConsoleViewer to IHyperlink to fix disabled context menu issue (Bug 229202).>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: eclipse-api-migration>

new org.eclipse.ui.internal.console.FollowHyperlinkAction($viewer) :: instanceof($viewer, "org.eclipse.ui.console.TextConsoleViewer")
=>
new org.eclipse.ui.internal.console.FollowHyperlinkAction($viewer.getHyperlink())
;;
summary: Update FollowHyperlinkAction constructor argument from TextConsoleViewer to TextConsoleViewer.getHyperlink()
